_readme: The site plays the small web cuts in /staf/assets/video/ (src). Google Drive blocks its files from playing on other websites (403 for cross-site requests), so Drive is only the archive: drive_id points to the same file in Drive folder 02_Film & Media/STAF Films/Nettside-video. To swap a video: export a short H.264 web cut (aim for under 3 MB), put it in assets/video/, upload the same file to Drive, and update src and drive_id here. Keep full-quality masters in Drive only.
